paragraphs.source_en: On the eighteenth day of the eighth month of Keichō 3, Tokugawa Ieyasu learned that Toyotomi Hideyoshi had passed away—an hour after Hideyoshi's death. Ieyasu had long known that Hideyoshi's death was only a matter of time. What surprised him was that the man who came to bring the news was Ishida Jibu-shōyū Mitsunari, who had always shown him unmistakable hostility.
